comment: Sample raw frame sets. See python/retina/samples.py.
Nothing is redistributed by Retina: the manifest only carries the upstream URL, the
SHA-256 digest of the file as published, its licence and its attribution.
Rule: no entry without an explicit licence AND a permanent identifier (DOI).
An unverifiable URL produces the failure nobody diagnoses.
The digests were computed on the files actually downloaded from Zenodo,
and the MD5 published by Zenodo was cross-checked along the way.

samples.name: Palomar LFC — cryogenic CCD, chip 0
samples.attribution: Erik Tollerud (STScI) and Matthew Craig (Minnesota State University Moorhead), CC BY 4.0
samples.note: Bias, darks, flats in two filters (g', i') and science frames of VV124, from chip 0 of the Large Format Camera on the Hale 5 m telescope at Palomar. Carries BIASSEC overscan and full IMAGETYP/EXPTIME/FILTER/INSTRUME identity: the whole calibration chain applies. Also used by the astropy CCD Data Reduction Guide.

samples.name: Feder Observatory — thermo-electric CCD (Andor Aspen CG16M)
samples.attribution: Matthew Craig (Minnesota State University Moorhead), CC BY 4.0
samples.note: Bias, darks, flats and science frames of KELT-16 b from the Paul P. Feder Observatory. A thermo-electrically cooled camera, closer to amateur equipment than the Palomar set: dark current matters, and the darks are there to show it.
